note: When a views-on root's checkout view cannot build its index for the installed snapshot, the readiness sample now reports the semantic source as Failed with the build error instead of falling back to the legacy semantic index (never built for views-on roots), and the search reply reports the lane as unavailable with that reason through the existing Failed-status wording. Views-off roots have no checkout view and take the unchanged path; scoring, fusion, routing for ready lanes and paging are untouched, so ranked rows stay byte-identical.
